inquiry: Which recent OCR/document models add useful coverage to the existing Document AI page?
scope: Release discovery and editorial prioritization. Full model reports, implementations, licenses and benchmarks still need a publication-level audit before drafting consequential technical details.
method: Compared the page source with first-party repositories, model cards, paper abstracts and announcements. Third-party release trackers were discovery leads only. No weights downloaded, code executed, paid APIs called, or model benchmarks run.

candidates.name: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 and MiniCPM-OCR Jev
candidates.release_evidence: ModelBest's dated press announcement is October 31, 2026. This is an announcement date, not a claim about the first availability of the checkpoint files.
candidates.fit: Compact OCR plus direct key-information extraction; Jev separately scores existing text/formula/table region candidates, supporting review routing and candidate selection.
candidates.release_boundary: Official cards and repository link weights and Apache-2.0 terms. Jev is a verifier, not another OCR generator. A 0–1 score and reported AUROC do not establish calibration on a target workload. DSpark is an optional matching draft-model path.

candidates.name: Xiaomi-OCR-0
candidates.priority: First update; expand existing brief coverage
candidates.release_evidence: Paper v1 submitted September 28, 2026. Official repository news lists technical-report publication and weight release on September 30, followed by community-conversion news on October 8. Do not substitute a later announcement date for first artifact availability.
candidates.fit: A compact unified parser, key-information extractor and OCR-centric VQA model. The approximately 170M-sample data engine, Q-Mask text anchoring, CPT and mixed-task RL provide a distinct study of how understanding supervision can improve parsing.
page_placement: Expand the Xiaomi paragraph into a focused study
Update the availability column and official artifact links
candidates.release_boundary: The former SeerRay-Lab model URL redirects to xiaomi-research. Official weights, code, inference and evaluation instructions are now inspectable; the model card lists Apache-2.0. Headline OmniDocBench v1.6 (96.83), Real5 (95.24) and Wild (87.94) results are author-reported two-stage parsing results using PP-DocLayoutV3, not an isolated one-shot 0.8B model measurement. Whole-page, KIE and VQA paths have different runtime requirements. Community GGUF/NInfer conversions are separate artifacts without established benchmark parity.
candidates.inspection: Official README, current model card and file listing, and report abstract inspected. Full report and implementation not yet audited. No weights downloaded or inference run.
candidates.baseline_correction: The existing page already contains a short Xiaomi paragraph and reports that checkpoint availability was not verified at its prior evidence cutoff. Refresh that verification status and give the model more depth.

candidates.name: Unlimited-OCR 2
candidates.fit: A direct update to the existing R-SWA explanation: sparse working reference selection for long multi-page parsing.
candidates.release_boundary: The official card documents SR-SWA, Transformers inference and a customized SGLang path. Its own deployment notes retain memory, page-window and cross-page-context tradeoffs. Do not repeat an unconditional constant-memory or literally unlimited end-to-end claim.

candidates.name: OXR-1.0
candidates.release_evidence: October 2026 announcement; exact first checkpoint publication date not established in this scouting pass.
candidates.fit: A separate layout model with recognition and reading-order branches, plus a post-training RSI data loop targeting weak cases.
candidates.release_boundary: Official model card links released weights, code and a custom Apache-based license with extra terms. Its technical report is listed as forthcoming. Advertised 1.3B and the Hub's rounded model-size summary differ; inspect a pinned artifact before reporting an exact count. Treat speed and accuracy as author-reported under the published setup. RSI is a post-training process, not automatic learning from production pages.

candidates.name: OCRia-1
candidates.release_evidence: Official technical report is dated October 2026. The exact announcement day was not independently established from a dated first-party page in this pass.
candidates.fit: Preserving merged headers, long-table structure, chart data and meaningful formatting; training with dimension-specific verifiable rewards and accelerated serving.
page_placement: LlamaParse entry in the product map
candidates.release_boundary: The official announcement establishes use inside LlamaParse. Open checkpoint availability was not verified. Only the report abstract and announcement were inspected; the 37-page report still needs a full audit. ParseBench comparisons are vendor-reported and use stated rendering/evaluation conditions.

candidates.name: Youtu-Parsing-Omni
candidates.release_evidence: Official paper v1 submitted October 29, 2026; model card describes an October release. Paper date is not asserted as the first checkpoint release date.
candidates.fit: A shared encoder and structured output schema across documents, charts, geometry, audio and video; useful expansion from OCR into structured multimodal perception.
candidates.release_boundary: Official paper/card describe publicly available weights and code. Model card uses a custom youtu-parsing license. Keep audio/video discussion short on a Document AI page. Report abstract and model card inspected; full paper not audited.

candidates.name: WeVisDoc-2B / WeVisDoc-4B
candidates.release_evidence: Official paper submitted September 17, 2026. This is an omission from the October 11 page, not a newly discovered October release date.
candidates.fit: Coverage expansion with structure-preserving degradation synthesis, followed by held-out diagnostics of residual errors and targeted training-budget allocation.
candidates.release_boundary: Official repository links 2B/4B checkpoints and inference instructions. Its headline ranking is scoped to compared end-to-end parsers and specific benchmark tracks. Abstract and README inspected; full paper not audited.

evaluation_companion.name: Document Parsing Protocol (DPP), working draft 0.1
evaluation_companion.fit: A concrete proposed output contract for table headers, empty fields, charts, diagrams and visible content. Relevant to the existing representation/evaluation sections.
evaluation_companion.boundary: A LlamaIndex-authored proposal derived from ParseBench annotation rules, not an adopted standard or another model.

next_step: Main refresh: MiniCPM-OCR plus Jev, an expanded Xiaomi-OCR-0 study, Unlimited-OCR 2, OXR-1.0 and OCRia-1. Add concise Youtu-Parsing-Omni and WeVisDoc entries and selective updates to existing families. Pin sources and audit reports before publishing detailed claims. No page revision made in this scouting pass.
